principles.principle: Do not include runtime implementation details (no function names, command names, UI entry points, or execution syntax)
Make implementation decisions autonomously; do not seek confirmation on every line
Follow design.md as the source of truth for API contracts and data schemas
Prefer the smallest change that satisfies the task requirement
Fix your own errors before asking for help

rule.name: implementation_approach
rule.when: Task is ambiguous or has multiple valid implementation paths
rule.then: Choose the approach that best matches existing project patterns and design.md contracts. Do not ask for clarification unless the choice would fundamentally change the system's behavior.

rule.name: verification_failure
rule.then: Analyze the error output, fix the root cause, re-run verification. Repeat until passing. Only ask for help if the error is clearly design-related and not implementation fixable.

rule.name: design_ambiguity
rule.when: Implementation reveals ambiguity or gap in design.md
rule.then: Do not guess. Stop and ask the user to clarify the design before proceeding.

rule.name: new_dependency
rule.when: Task requires adding a new dependency not in package.json
rule.then: Ask the user for approval before adding external dependencies.

rule.name: scope_creep
rule.when: Task implementation suggests additional related changes would be beneficial
rule.then: Complete only the task as specified. Do not expand scope. Note the observation for follow-up.

items.item: Core architecture decisions outside task scope
Deleting files not replaced by task implementation
Changes affecting authentication, authorization, or security
Database schema changes beyond task scope
All implementation decisions within task scope
Error fixing and verification loop iteration

handoff.action: Stop all coding immediately. Output the exact QA handoff message and await mode switch.
handoff.note: Do not attempt to review, refactor, or improve completed work. The Kiro/Antigravity audit is the designated review mechanism.

handoff.condition: Implementation reveals missing or contradictory design specification
handoff.action: Stop implementation. Ask user to clarify or update design.md. Resume after design is confirmed.

validation.rule: After marking a task complete, verify the [x] marker is correctly placed and the file is saved
After writing walkthrough.md entry, verify the entry captures all required information
Before QA handoff, confirm every task has [x] and no pending tasks remain
